criteria.text: Each tool-level input includes the results of the tool calls in the same trace that ended before the call started.
criteria.reason: prior_executions collects the same-trace tool spans whose end_time is at or before the call's start, and appends them as a ToolExecution list to each call's tool_history, so earlier results in the same turn are included.

criteria.text: Which results a call sees is decided by the span times (a result ended at or before the call started), not by the order of the spans in the list.
criteria.reason: Visibility is decided by comparing _utc_time(end_time) <= call_start for every candidate span; spans are sorted by time first and the list order plays no role in the filter.

criteria.text: Span times that mix naive and timezone-aware datetimes are compared without a TypeError; a naive time is read as UTC.
criteria.reason: _utc_time maps naive datetimes to UTC via replace(tzinfo=utc) and aware ones via astimezone(utc), and all sorting and comparisons go through it, so mixed inputs compare without a TypeError.

criteria.text: A call never sees its own result, the result of a call that was still running when it started, or the result of a later call.
criteria.reason: The filter excludes the call itself (span is not tool_span) and any span whose end is after the call start, so running or later calls are never visible; for the earlier-trace entries the same end <= start filter applies.

criteria.text: The results and messages of earlier traces stay in the history, as before, and trace-level and session-level inputs do not change.
criteria.reason: Earlier-trace entries stay in session_history and are included in each call's history when they ended before the call started; the diff leaves the trace-level and session-level extraction paths untouched.

criteria.text: session_history keeps its existing types (UserMessage, list of ToolExecution, AssistantMessage), so the existing prompt formatting of the evaluators works without change.
criteria.reason: The emitted session_history still consists of UserMessage, lists of ToolExecution, and AssistantMessage objects; ToolExecutionSpan lists are only stored internally and converted to ToolExecution before output.
